name: B10-0165/2025 (ESN) – Continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text:
This resolution is an opinion. It does not change any law. It asks the European Union to stop promising military support to Ukraine "as long as it takes" and to push for talks instead. It wants the EU to set its own foreign policy, talk directly to Russia, and tie rebuilding Ukraine to deals that benefit European businesses. It also asks Ukraine to ban a watchdog group and symbols linked to wartime nationalist groups.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a request for a new EU approach: talks over weapons.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, Ukraine, Russia, and European taxpayers funding reconstruction.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU leaders and institutions. They decide whether to act on it.
